transliteration: aśvarūpyahiraṇyānāṃ dhānyalohājavāsasām | carmakāṣṭhavikārāṇām ekāhaṃ syāt parīkṣaṇam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Examination of horses, gold, grain, iron, goats, cloth, leather, wood, and their derivatives shall be completed within one day.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in timely execution of verification
Causation aligns with immediacy of inspection
Restoration logic requires swift validation of material truth
Consciousness alignment occurs through punctual fulfillment of duty
executable_legal_axioms: IF property_type IN [horse, gold, grain, iron, goat, cloth, leather, wood, derivative] THEN maximum_inspection_time = 1 day
IF inspection_duration > 1 day THEN initiate_capacity_realignment_protocol FOR inspector
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall mandate that all lower judicial bodies execute material inspections within a single solar cycle to uphold Dharma-speed justice. Delay reflects misalignment of consciousness, not procedural necessity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that delayed inspection disrupts economic flow and social trust. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential accountability without punitive attribution. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring inspection capacity, not inflicting consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate one-day completion process for pending inspections
Assign consciousness-alignment mentor to habitual delayers
Deploy automated reminder system aligned with solar cycles
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, inspection time is set at one day. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
